name: restate/testing
description: Test harness for Restate PHP services: starts Restate in a container and your endpoint, registers it and hands out an ingress client. Install it as a dev dependency.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Lets a test run interrupted with Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or SIGTERM stop the Restate container and the endpoint it started.
suggest.ext-posix: Lets RestateTestEnvironment::killEndpoint() signal the php -S workers directly instead of running kill(1).
suggest.guzzlehttp/psr7: The default PSR-17 factories of Restate\Testing\RestateTestEnvironment::ingressClient() (guzzlehttp/guzzle requires it).
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required to use the Restate\Testing\PHPUnit\InteractsWithRestate trait (PHPUnit 10 or newer).
